description: 大分県有財産一覧(公共施設一覧) [evacuation shelters and public facilities] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 大分県. 大分県が所有する土地・建物の一覧です。 建物の一覧は、自治体標準ODS：公共施設一覧に準拠しています。. Coverage: 大分県. The portal files it under the publisher 大分県. Its tags are 位置情報, 公共施設, 土地, 建物, 自治体標準ODS. It offers 4 resource(s) in csv, geojson. The portal shows 2025-02-28 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
